name: hull_ma_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, micro-momentum shifts driven by VWAP algo re-benchmarking and delta-hedging flows create short 15-90 second directional bursts. The Hull Moving Average (HMA) on a 2-minute window at 5-second resolution detects these bursts ~50% earlier than EMA because its double-WMA construction cancels lag. When HMA slope flips from negative to positive (bullish) and NIFTY is above VWAP, the flip signals that buy-side institutional flow has just overwhelmed sell pressure — VWAP algos accumulating below their benchmark create a self-reinforcing 10-20 spot point push over the next 30-90 seconds. The VWAP alignment filter ensures we enter only when institutional delta-hedgers and index fund rebalancers are on our side.

indicators.name: HMA_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute HMA on 5s bars — NOT 12x scaled (that would give 192 bars = 16 min, identical to original, wrong timeframe). We hold 15-120s so the trigger should resolve in ~2 min. HMA(24) = 120s covers the full expected hold window, giving the slope flip predictive value for the next 15-120s rather than the next 10-30 min.

indicators.name: HMA_slope
indicators.purpose: Direction of HMA — slope flip (sign change) is the primary entry trigger.

indicators.name: VWAP
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP as institutional benchmark filter. Buy CE only when close > VWAP (confirming buy-side institutional pressure). Cumulative — no scaling needed.

indicators.name: vol_sma_60
indicators.purpose: 5-minute volume average (60 bars × 5s). Volume must be above this average to confirm real order flow behind the HMA flip, not just noise in a thin-market period.

indicators.name: flip_count_30
indicators.formula: count of HMA slope sign changes in last 30 bars
indicators.purpose: Choppiness filter — if HMA flipped >4 times in 150 seconds, the market is in a range and every flip is noise, not signal.

conditions: HMA_slope just flipped positive (slope[t] > 0 AND slope[t-1] <= 0)
abs(HMA_slope) >= hma_threshold (flip is large enough to be real)
buy_ce.confirmation: Single-bar flip detection — at 5s speed, waiting for 2-bar confirmation (10s) sacrifices most of the move; slope magnitude filter replaces confirmation

conditions: HMA_slope just flipped negative (slope[t] < 0 AND slope[t-1] >= 0)

exit.stop_rationale: NIFTY 30-90 second moves average 2-5 option pts; a 4 pt stop gives room for normal noise (1-2 pt oscillations) while cutting losses if the flip proves false. If NIFTY reverses 8 spot pts within 30s of entry, the HMA flip thesis has failed — 4 pts is half that retracement at delta ~0.5.
exit.target_rationale: A real HMA flip on NIFTY with VWAP confirmation typically initiates a 15-25 spot point run in 30-90s (confirmed by the institutional flow mechanism). At delta ~0.5, that's 7-12 option pts. A 7 pt target captures the lower bound of a genuine momentum burst — 1:1.75 R:R with 4 pt stop.

filters.vix_filter: none — HMA momentum is valid across all VIX regimes; choppy filter (flip_count_30) handles elevated VIX indirectly
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST (skip first 10 min for HMA warmup and pre-open noise)
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment (close above/below VWAP for CE/PE)
filters.choppiness_filter: skip if HMA flipped > 4 times in last 150 seconds (range-bound)

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — HMA flips are a mechanical signal; once known, can be front-run. However, index momentum at 5s is driven by structural flows (delta-hedging, VWAP algos) not by traders watching HMA.

adaptation_notes: Original used HMA(16) on 1-min bars of NIFTY200 stocks, holding 10-30 min. The original notes explicitly flagged negative edge after equity costs (~11 bps). CHANGED: (1) Timeframe compressed from 1-min to 5s bars — lookback reduced from 16 min to 2 min (24 bars) to match 15-120s hold. (2) Universe changed from individual stocks to NIFTY index — removes stock-specific noise, adds institutional flow regularity. (3) Cost structure fundamentally different: ~0.6 pt breakeven on options vs ~11 bps on equity. (4) Volume filter changed from SMA(volume,20) on 1-min to SMA(volume,60) on 5s (same 5-min window). (5) Choppiness filter retained from original (>5 flips in 30 bars). (6) The negative edge in original was cost-driven, not signal-driven — 48% win rate at 1.6:1 R:R is positive gross; options cost structure makes this viable.
weaknesses: HMA(24) on 5s is very sensitive — market microstructure noise on NIFTY can produce spurious flips
Slope magnitude threshold hma_threshold requires tuning — too low fires on noise, too high misses moves
VWAP filter means strategy is inactive for assets trending strongly below VWAP in buy_ce mode — asymmetric opportunity
flip_count_30 choppiness filter may miss valid re-entries in intraday range days
